dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Oh relax! With my considerable wealth, I'm sure I won't easily go broke.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Even if it's just half of my wealth, it's still three times the worth of the Kalimi Exchange!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: See this antique? Ten a penny in my house. Take it if you want it!
